bundle.shortDescription: Systematic literature reviews following SPAR-4-SLR and PRISMA 2020.
bundle.longDescription: Reeves is a desktop application for systematic literature reviews following the SPAR-4-SLR protocol and PRISMA 2020. Projects and usage statistics are stored locally. Reference lookups, open-access PDF searches and the built-in database browser use the internet, and article text is sent to whichever AI model server you configure.
